summary: Frontend-only testing of new Photo Cropper feature + regressions. All 9 targeted flows PASSED: upload opens cropper dialog with viewport/zoom/save/cancel, save produces data:image/jpeg thumbnail, re-crop reopens with previous original, cancel preserves photo, Fotoğraflı template's cv-photo displays the cropped image (object-cover circle), remove clears both photo and photoOriginal, cropped photo persists in localStorage 'ats-cv-data-v1' (personal.photo, photoOriginal, photoCrop) and survives reload, PDF download works for 'template-fotografli' with embedded photo (Ahmet_Yılmaz_CV.pdf). Template switching (modern/klasik/minimal/kompakt/fotografli), load-sample-button, clear-form-button, job-matcher all present and switchable.

issues: Radix warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent — a11y improvement, non-blocking.
Console warning: 'Buffer is not defined' emitted while generating PDF. PDF still downloads successfully, but consider polyfilling Buffer to silence.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to PhotoCropperDialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
(Nice-to-have) Polyfill Buffer for react-pdf to silence 'Buffer is not defined' warning during PDF generation.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoCropperDialog uses external element for drawImage source — canvas may be tainted if src ever becomes cross-origin; currently OK since src is a data URL from fileToResizedDataUrl, so no CORS risk in practice.
onCropSave replaces personal.photo but never falls back to raw upload if user closes dialog without saving; acceptable since photo stays empty until Uygula pressed.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test_photo.png (300x200 gradient) as upload fixture; localStorage cleared before run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Photo cropper flow fully working. ats-score testid was not found on the page (count=0) but not in scope; job-matcher present. If retesting, use page.set_input_files on '[data-testid="input-photo"]' and drive zoom via focusing slider role element then ArrowRight keys (pointer drag not needed).
